slides.headline: Your kitchen might not need a gut job
questions to answer before any remodel
slides.body: What has to change? What can stay? What will the permit require? Answer those three first and the scope, the schedule, and the budget get a lot easier to pin down.

slides.headline: Keep the layout. Change everything you touch.
slides.body: Moving plumbing and walls is where budgets grow. New cabinets, counters, flooring, lighting, and paint can transform a room without relocating a single pipe.
